title: Spicy Adana Kebap
description: A flavorful and spicy Turkish kebap recipe made with lamb, onions, and bell peppers. This recipe is perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: Lamb mince
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use lean lamb mince for a healthier option.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Finely chop the onion and mix it well with the lamb mince.

ingredients.name: Bell pepper
ingredients.notes: Finely chop the bell pepper and add it to the lamb mince mixture.

ingredients.name: Spicy tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality spicy tomato paste for extra flavor.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a good quality olive oil for cooking.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Season with black pepper to taste.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.notes: Chop the parsley and use it as a garnish.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the finely chopped onion and cook until it's translucent.
Add the finely chopped bell pepper and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the lamb mince mixture and cook until it's browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the spicy tomato paste and cook for another minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Adana kebap hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
